item.text:
“Request arrival” now uses the same primary style as “Open counter hours” in [index.html](/tmp/local-form-rnfalq5_/index.html:7). “Clear” retains its secondary style.

I verified both styles in Chromium and confirmed that empty-name validation, click and keyboard submission, and form reset still work. The submission test saved a sample arrival in the local browser.
